none: PAS HAMP-2FC483: Roman Samian ware vessel
contea di ritrovamento: Greater London (Inghilterra e Galles)

One base sherd (with damaged foot-ring) of Roman Samian ware. The base fragment measures 35.41x28.90x5.59mm, while the foot ring measures 33.58mm in diameter and is 11.19mm tall. Thus the dimensions of the fragment are 35.41x33.58x16.78mm. It weighs 12.83g. On the inside surface of the base is a rectangular stamp with IXI in relief.
